name: Lesser Gray Dwarf
description_html:
• +2 Constitution, -4 Charisma. These adjustments replace the dwarf ability adjustments.
  • Medium.
  • Lesser gray dwarf base land speed is 20 feet. However, lesser gray dwarves can move at this speed even when wearing medium or heavy armor or when carrying a medium or heavy load.
  • Darkvision up to 60 feet.
  • Stonecunning: +2 bonus on Search checks to notice unusual stonework. A lesser gray dwarf within 10 feet of unusual stonework can Search as if actively searching, can find stonework traps as a rogue can, and can intuit approximate depth underground.
  • Stability: +4 bonus on ability checks made to resist a bull rush or trip while standing on the ground.
  • +1 bonus on attack rolls against orcs and goblinoids.
  • +4 dodge bonus to Armor Class against giants.
  • +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poison, phantasms, and paralysis. This replaces the dwarf bonus on saves against poison.
  • +2 bonus on Appraise checks related to stone or metal items.
  • +2 bonus on Craft checks related to stone or metal.
  • +2 racial bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks.
  • Spell-like abilities: 1/day enlarge person. Caster level equals twice the lesser gray dwarf's class levels (minimum 3rd). The ability affects only the lesser gray dwarf and whatever he carries.
  • Light sensitivity: dazzled in bright sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell.
  • Weapon familiarity: lesser gray dwarves do not have weapon familiarity with the dwarven waraxe or the dwarven urgrosh.
  • Automatic Languages: Common and Dwarven.
  • Bonus Languages: Giant, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, Terran, and Undercommon.
  • Favored Class: Fighter.
  • Level adjustment +0.

name: Lesser Drow
description_html:
• +2 Dexterity, -2 Constitution. These adjustments replace the elf ability adjustments.
  • Medium.
  • Lesser drow base land speed is 30 feet.
  • Immunity to magic sleep effects.
  • Darkvision up to 60 feet. This replaces the elf ability to see twice as far in dim light.
  • Weapon proficiency: hand crossbow, rapier, and short sword. These replace the elf weapon proficiencies.
  • +2 racial bonus on Listen, Search, and Spot checks.
  • +2 racial bonus on Will saves against spells and spell-like effects.
  • Spell-like abilities: if Charisma is at least 10, 1/day dancing lights, daze, and touch of fatigue. Caster level equals the lesser drow's class levels.
  • Light blindness: abrupt exposure to bright light (sunlight or a daylight spell) blinds a lesser drow for 1 round. On later rounds, the lesser drow is dazzled while remaining in the area.
  • Automatic Languages: Common and Elven.
  • Bonus Languages: Draconic, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, and Sylvan.
  • Favored Class: Wizard (male) or cleric (female).
  • Level adjustment +0.

name: Lesser Deep Gnome
description_html:
• -2 Strength, +2 Dexterity. These adjustments replace the gnome ability adjustments.
  • Small.
  • Lesser deep gnome base land speed is 20 feet.
  • Low-light vision.
  • Darkvision up to 60 feet.
  • Stonecunning: +2 bonus on Search checks to notice unusual stonework. A lesser deep gnome within 10 feet of unusual stonework can Search as if actively searching, can find stonework traps as a rogue can, and can intuit approximate depth underground.
  • +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like effects. This replaces the gnome bonus on saves against illusions.
  • +1 dodge bonus to Armor Class against all creatures. This replaces the gnome dodge bonus against giants.
  • +1 bonus on attack rolls against kobolds and goblinoids.
  • +2 racial bonus on Listen checks.
  • +2 bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks.
  • Weapon familiarity: gnome hooked hammers are martial weapons.
  • +1 to the Difficulty Class of illusion spells cast by a lesser deep gnome.
  • Spell-like abilities: 1/day speak with animals (burrowing mammal only), dancing lights, ghost sound, and prestidigitation. Caster level 1st. Save DC is 10 + spell level + Charisma modifier.
  • Spell-like abilities: 1/day resistance, daze, and lullaby. Caster level equals one-half the lesser deep gnome's character level. Save DC is 10 + spell level + Charisma modifier.
  • +2 racial bonus on Hide checks. This bonus improves to +4 underground.
  • Automatic Languages: Common and Gnome.
  • Bonus Languages: Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Goblin, and Orc.
  • Favored Class: Rogue.
  • Level adjustment +0.

name: Lesser Water Genasi
description_html:
Lesser water genasi use the standard water genasi racial traits with the Lesser Planetouched changes from Player's Guide to Faerûn (pages 190-191): humanoid (planetouched) type and level adjustment +0.

  • +2 Constitution, -2 Charisma
  • Swim speed 30 ft.
  • Darkvision 60 ft.
  • Create water 1/day (Sp), caster level 5th
  • +1 on saves against water spells and effects, +1 more per five class levels
  • Can breathe water
  • Cleric must take the Water domain
  • Favored class: Fighter

identity.bonus_languages: Any (except secret languages, such as Druidic)

traits.name: Spell-Like Abilities
traits.text:
Spell-Like Abilities

Create Water (Sp): Once per day, a lesser water genasi can use create water. Caster level 5th.

traits.name: Water Affinity
traits.text:
Water Affinity

Lesser water genasi have a +1 racial bonus on saving throws against water spells and effects. This bonus increases by +1 for every five class levels the genasi attains.

traits.name: Breathe Water
traits.text:
Breathe Water

Lesser water genasi can breathe water as easily as air. This is an extraordinary ability.

traits.name: Clerical Focus
traits.text:
Clerical Focus

A lesser water genasi cleric must choose a deity who grants the Water domain, and must select Water as one of their two domains.

traits.name: Planetouched
traits.text:
Planetouched

Lesser water genasi are humanoids with the planetouched subtype, not outsiders. Spells and effects that target humanoids, such as charm person, affect them, and so do effects that target outsiders, such as banishment. This replaces the outsider type and the level adjustment of the standard water genasi.
